caption: The drawing depicts a tall grandfather clock featuring a predominantly wooden case colored in shades of reddish-brown. The clock has a rectangular base with a door, fitted with a metal handle and keyhole on the right side, and is supported by four small brass casters or feet. The middle section, which houses the pendulum, has a glass window with a decorative curved edge, revealing the internal components. The upper section contains the large, circular clock face, which is light gray with black Arabic numerals and black clock hands. The top of the clock case is ornate, with a central pointed finial and two smaller side finials, along with decorative scrollwork on the pediment and edges, all echoing the dark reddish-brown color of the wood. The background is plain off-white with a faint rectangular border framing the drawing, and the artist's name is signed in small letters at the lower left corner.
title: Shelf Clock
